title: Nazi Antarctica expedition

plain: Around 1938 and 1939, Nazi Germany sent an expedition to Antarctica. Talking with a writer, Peter Levenda, a podcast host named Jesse Michels says that this Antarctica expedition was very real. It comes up because, in stories like these, the trip is linked to secret Nazi interest in the far south.
